field_principles.status: Records the terminal Exp6547 independent audit state.

field_principles.verdict_class: Separates clean, partial, blocked, and disqualified audit outcomes.
field_principles.input_disposition_rows: Records existence, hashes, status, verdict class, and ready score for each required upstream artifact.
field_principles.router_row_recomputation: Recomputes structural and learned-router effects from rows instead of trusted aggregates.
field_principles.cost_guard_row_recomputation: Recomputes SOTA guarded versus unguarded effects from rows instead of trusted aggregates.
field_principles.independent_exact_replay_rows: Samples exact replay receipts and checks row-level equality against the audited fixture authority.
field_principles.source_equivalence_rows: Checks proof-preserving surface and source-equivalence receipts before adopting any transfer claim.
field_principles.model_identity_audit_rows: Verifies mandated GGUF IDs, local model paths, hashes, loader identity, and substitution resistance.
field_principles.exception_and_fixture_hash_receipts: Pins fixture, exception table, checkpoint, model registry, and protected inputs by hash.
field_principles.candidate_and_fallback_audit: Checks candidate preservation, abstention, fallback reachability, and exact equality across router rows.
field_principles.calibration_audit_rows: Checks train-only fitting and development-only calibration boundaries.
field_principles.token_time_and_tool_cost_audit: Recomputes prompt tokens, output tokens, model time, tool time, charged time, and charged tokens.
field_principles.censoring_and_terminal_coverage: Checks timeouts, parse failures, nonterminal rows, checkpoint coverage, and exact completion.
field_principles.shortcut_attack_matrix: Attacks identity, entity names, row order, leakage, prompt length, cache order, timing, duplicates, null rows, hidden writes, omitted tool cost, and aggregate tampering.
field_principles.lane_dispositions: Keeps router and cost-guard dispositions separate so one lane cannot rescue or suppress the other.
field_principles.external_transfer_audited_ready_score: Opens only when row-supported eligible claims pass every adopted independent check.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names failed checks with expected and observed values.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Flattens independent row checks used by the aggregate reducer.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Rebuilds the final score and verdict class from rows and lane dispositions.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records paths, hashes, code hashes, solver receipts, model receipts, resources, seed, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded source and evidence files stayed byte-identical during the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares a deterministic external router, cost, and exact replay audit with no LLM inference.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True only for audit checks; the artifact makes no new positive scientific claim.

field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to rows, upstream artifacts, checks, tests, and hashes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic replay sampling and attack ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in inputs, rows, lane dispositions, gates, and verdict.
